comparison.objective: Hand scissors to a mannequin hand with handles first; candidate tunes an industrial-axis shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Safe grasp orientation and interpersonal handover versus precision tool insertion, bimanual adjustment, controlled tightening, and test actuation.
comparison.success_condition: Scissors must be handed over handles-first; candidate requires two compliant stops and a stable locked setting. Setup and scoring fields are missing.
comparison.reason: Safe handover is unrelated to dynamic mechanical commissioning despite both imposing safety constraints.
